summary: Iteration 3 full test of Uonogamesapk.com App Detail page + admin new fields + credential rotation retest. Backend pytest: 31/31 passed (28 previous + 3 new detail tests). Old admin credentials (admin@uonogamesapk.com / Admin@12345) now correctly return 401 — seed()'s delete_many({'role':'admin','email':{$ne:admin_email}}) works. New tests verify: (a) every seeded app has developer/package_name/min_android/whats_new/screenshots after backfill, (b) POST /admin/apps persists all 5 new fields end-to-end, (c) PUT /admin/apps/{id} uses exclude_unset — updating only 'developer' does NOT wipe package_name/min_android/whats_new/screenshots; updating only 'screenshots' replaces the array correctly. Frontend: from Store, clicking featured-main and app-card navigates to /app/{id}; download buttons on cards call stopPropagation (verified — URL unchanged after clicking download-btn-{id}). Detail page renders detail-name, detail-description, 3 detail-screenshot-* images, additional info table with Developer/Package/Requires/Version, What's New section, detail-download-btn + detail-download-sticky (both open ${API}/apps/{id}/download and show toast), detail-share, detail-back, detail-back-home on 404. Admin login with new creds arfuu9@gmail.com/arfuu7778 succeeds; Add New App form contains all new testids (form-developer, form-min-android, form-package, form-whats-new, upload-screenshot). Full e2e: created TEST_UI_Detail app with all new fields via admin -> found in store search -> opened its detail page -> confirmed all 5 field values render.

minor.issue: Passing an obviously-invalid id returns 400 with detail 'Invalid app id' (via to_object_id). A syntactically valid but non-existent 24-char ObjectId correctly returns 404. Behavior is fine, just noting.

ui_bugs.issue: When sonner toasts are stacked at the top of the screen after clicking download, they visually overlap the sticky header on mobile 390px viewport and can intercept the detail-back click for a couple of seconds until toasts fade. Not a functional blocker (back still works after toast timeout), but consider positioning toasts below the header or using bottom position on the detail page.

action_items: OPTIONAL/LOW: Move sonner toaster to bottom on AppDetail page OR raise header z-index above the toast container so detail-back is always tappable while a toast is on-screen.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py seed(): the delete_many for stale admins runs BEFORE the insert/update block — correct order; verified old creds are now rejected.

server.py update_app uses model_dump(exclude_unset=True) — partial updates now safe. Verified by test_partial_update_exclude_unset (updating one field preserves the rest, including screenshots array).

server.py seed() backfills detail fields with update_many({'developer':{'$exists':False}}, ...). Idempotent, only touches legacy docs; new apps created via admin already include the fields via AppCreate defaults. Good.
AppDetail.jsx handleDownload uses window.open(`${API}/apps/${id}/download`) — this navigates in a new tab and the backend returns 302 to apk_url. Works. downloads state increments locally too.
AppCard.jsx / FeaturedApps.jsx: download buttons have onClick={(e)=>{e.stopPropagation(); onDownload(app)}} — verified in browser that URL does NOT change after clicking the yellow download pill.
AdminDashboard.jsx EMPTY constant now includes developer/package_name/min_android/whats_new/screenshots — new-app dialog opens with sensible defaults (min_android='Android 6.0+', screenshots=[]).

FileUpload inside 'Screenshots' passes value='' so it always shows 'Upload Screenshot' — good; each upload appends via setField('screenshots', [...form.screenshots, url]) and remove-screenshot-{i} buttons work.
AppDetail.jsx renders Additional Info as an array of [k,v] pairs — Developer & Package fall back to '—' when empty. Handles empty seed correctly.
detail-share uses navigator.share where available and falls back to navigator.clipboard.writeText — proper progressive enhancement.
No _id leakage: serialize_app strips _id and returns id string. Verified in test_list_faqs_seeded assertion 'assert "_id" not in f' and by all detail responses containing only 'id'.
server.py is ~530 lines total — still comfortably under the 700-line file-size guideline, no split needed yet.

Frontend token/auth uses cookies (httpOnly access_token) — localStorage.getItem('token') returned null in my cleanup script; noting for future testing agents that admin API calls from browser rely on the cookie set by the login endpoint (or a bearer stored elsewhere in AuthContext).

rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no bugs found this iteration. Previous iteration's high-priority bug (old-creds-still-work) is confirmed FIXED: pytest test_old_admin_credentials_rejected returns 401 as required. RCA of the fix: seed() at server.py:469 now runs `await db.users.delete_many({'role':'admin','email':{'$ne':admin_email}})` before the insert/update block, which purges the stale admin@uonogamesapk.com document on every startup, so only the current ADMIN_EMAIL user exists in db.users.
